gaps.spec_claim: Returns a non-negative float equal to the sum of weighted token-match contributions across multiple independent signal categories. The function name is decomposed into lowercase parts, and each part is tested for exact membership in distinct signal sets, with each set contributing a fixed per-match weight: backtick-identifier overlap contributes a weight higher than body-level backtick overlap; dotted-reference overlap contributes the highest per-match weight among identifier categories; plain-identifier overlap contributes a moderate weight; all-words overlap from name-parts is limited to parts of at least 5 characters and contributes a low weight. The full name is tested case-insensitively against traceback-function signals with the highest single-match weight. Identifiers in idents are tested against backtick-identifier signals with moderate per-match weight. Exception types in exc_types are tested for exact membership in exception-type signals with moderate per-match weight. Body words in body_words are tested against all-words signals, and the raw overlap count is divided by the square root of body_lines before multiplying by the lowest per-match weight. A fuzzy string-similarity match between name parts and identifier-like signal tokens contributes a bounded additional term, requiring both strings to exceed a minimum character-length threshold and a similarity exceeding a fixed ratio threshold. Each component is independent and adds additively to the total. The return value is deterministic: identical arguments always produce identical results. The result is zero when no metadata facet matches any signal token in any category and body_words shares no tokens with all-words signals.
gaps.actual_behavior: Let $parts = \text{\_name\_parts}(name)$. The function returns the float value $$\begin{aligned} \text{score} = &\; \bigl( \exists\, tf \in \text{signals}[`traceback\_funcs'] \;:\; tf.\text{lower}() = name.\text{lower}() \;\lor\; tf.\text{lower}() \in parts \;\;?\; W_{\text{TRACEBACK}} : 0 \bigr) \\ &+ |parts \cap \text{signals}[`backtick\_idents']| \cdot W_{\text{BACKTICK\_NAME}} \\ &+ |idents \cap \text{signals}[`backtick\_idents']| \cdot W_{\text{BACKTICK\_BODY}} \\ &+ |parts \cap \text{signals}[`dotted\_refs']| \cdot W_{\text{DOTTED\_REF}} \\ &+ |parts \cap \text{signals}[`plain\_idents']| \cdot W_{\text{PLAIN\_NAME}} \\ &+ |\{\,p \in parts \mid \text{len}(p) \ge 5\,\} \cap \text{signals}[`all\_words']| \cdot W_{\text{NAME\_ALL\_WORDS}} \\ &+ \text{\_fuzzy\_name\_score}(parts, \text{signals}) \\ &+ \bigl( \text{signals}[`exception\_types'] \ne \emptyset \;\land\; exc\_types \ne \emptyset \;\;?\; |\text{signals}[`exception\_types'] \cap exc\_types| \cdot W_{\text{EXCEPTION\_MATCH}} : 0 \bigr) \\ &+ \frac{|body\_words \cap \text{signals}[`all\_words']|}{\sqrt{\max(body\_lines, 1)}} \cdot W_{\text{BODY\_WORDS}}. \end{aligned}$$ The term $\text{\_fuzzy\_name\_score}(parts, \text{signals})$ is a nonnegative float bounded by a small fraction of the maximum possible identifiercategory score. All input arguments remain unchanged.

gaps.trigger_condition: The specification requires that only the full name is tested case-insensitively against traceback-function signals. The code additionally matches any traceback function name against individual name parts, causing a false positive contribution (W_TRACEBACK) when a part (but not the full name) matches a traceback function.
